blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Talia Gibson – Pan Pacific Open Round of 16 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala stormed back to beat Australia’s Talia Gibson, 4-6, 6-2, 6-0, and reach the Toray Pan Pacific Open quarterfinals on Wednesday night in Tokyo, Japan. Eala clinched her first WTA quarterfinal appearance since August 1, when she won her maiden WTA title at the Washington Open. “I think really staying in the match, never giving up, the first set was difficult and I had my chances so I knew that if I kept my concentration I would have more chances [at winning],” said the eighth-seeded Eala.
